title: Specialty Product
paragraphs: “Hmm… Kuro, what kind of name do you want?”
Father was asking Kuro-chan. Kuro-chan seems to like cool names. I don’t quite understand the appeal, but it must be something wonderful.
“Then for Nao… ‘Absolute Defense Unsinkable Battleship <Aegis>,’ and for Itsu… ‘Master of Holding Back.’”
“I’m not taking that insult!”
Itsuki glared at Kuro-chan with displeasure. Haha, it’s a fitting name for Itsuki. I was about to laugh, but he glared at me, so I kept quiet.
“Come on now… Kuro-chan, you like giving some really unique names.”
“Speaking of which, Itsuki used the title ‘Perfect Hidden Justice’ in the first world. It means Perfect, Concealment, and Justice.”
“Cool! Then from now on, it’s ‘Perfect Concealment Justice!’”
“Why does ‘Question’ have to be in there?! And what’s with ‘Perfect Hidden Justice’!?”
“It was your ring name in Zeltoble.”
“How twisted was I in the first world?!”
Itsuki was messing up his hair, trying to suppress his anger.
“Fuzzy!”
Kou was staring at Itsuki’s hair in excitement. This is bad… It feels like things are about to go the way they usually do.
“Such an interesting sense of naming…”
“Ugh, enough! Naofumi, do something! Give Kuro a ridiculous, embarrassing, chuunibyou name!”
“Hey, I’m not doing that! And why are you treating me like your subordinate? Besides, he’d just be happy if I did that.”
“Yet you’re totally getting into it…”
“Shakiiin!”

Kuro-chan struck a pose, raising his elbow at a weird angle and covering his right eye with his hand to look cool. He had a face that looked like he was confident of victory. It feels like I’ve seen this in some anime before.
“Why did the Filolials that came to me all turn out like this…?”
“According to the research records Motoyasu heard, the environment after they’re born has an effect… Maybe Kuro thought Ren’s attitude was cool?”
“Come to think of it, Ren did spoil Kuro a lot when he was a chick just because he was black. This is your fault!”
“Motoyasu was supposed to be the owner! Shut up, Perfect Concealment Justice!”
“Even you’re saying it now?!”

I don’t know that much about their personalities either. But it’s true that Ren took a liking to Kuro-chan when he was a chick. Kuro-chan must have remembered that and grown fond of Ren. Then, hearing little comments and mutterings, he must have decided that was what Ren liked.
“Hmm…”
Father, Big Sister’s friend, and Fiancée all crossed their arms and looked at the Filolials.
“They sure are a unique bunch.”
“Hm?”

Sakura stood behind Fiancée and Father, as if protecting them. Yuki was next to me. Kou was near Big Sister’s friend and Itsuki. Kuro-chan was playing around with Ren and Keel. There were also a few slaves, but they were completely hidden in the background. Honestly, Big Sister was way too plain in comparison.
“Cheer up too, Raphtalia-chan!”
“I-I’m fine!”

Sakura-chan hugged Big Sister from behind, and she protested. There are still times when she forces a smile. Although it seems the frequency has decreased quite a bit. After the Filolials started chatting like that, we used magic to turn threads into fabric for making clothes. Kuro-chan wanted cool clothes, so it’s going to be a bit of a challenge.

Maybe I’ll model them after what Father wore in the first world? After that, the heroes did some combat training to improve their teamwork. I explained what I learned from the previous loop to Father and the others. It was about Itsuki’s excellent support abilities, Ren’s tendency to accidentally hit allies, and how tough Father is and his fighting style. We practiced by using slightly weakened weapons to spar with monsters. I wanted to let Big Sister join the fight, but she just watched. In fact, her friend and Keel were the ones who were more eager to participate… Ah, Big Sister from the first world feels so distant.
Is it as hard for her to regain that heroic figure as it was for Filo-tan? Well, at least she looked like she was having fun playing around with the Filolials.
“Refana-chan, Raphtalia-chan, and Keel-kun seem to be having a hard time with their growing pains.”

After that, a few relatively quiet days passed. Big Sister and the others entered a growth spurt along with their level increase. Since they were finding it difficult to fight due to the rapid level-up, they stayed at the hotel to rest. They’re getting hungry more often, so it’s been quite a task.
“Everyone eats a lot.”
“Naofumi, aren’t you going to cook again?”
By the way, we’ve been eating the food provided by the hotel. I do miss Father’s cooking.
“The hotel’s food is good enough, isn’t it?”
“But the slaves keep talking about Naofumi’s cooking. They said it was incredibly delicious.”
“…Isn’t it more like Ren and Itsuki want to eat it?”
When Father asked, both Ren and Itsuki averted their gazes.
“Well, since it’s another world, if you go by Japanese standards, the taste might be a little bland and not quite right.”
Father said that with a sigh.
“By the way, in the previous loop, Ren and Itsuki were practically slaves to Father’s cooking. They asked for it whenever possible.”
Yes, that’s exactly why the previous Father said he wouldn’t spoil them too much. But since he cooked again recently, Ren and Itsuki must have realized just how good Father’s cooking is.
“I can’t say I don’t understand.”
“Isn’t the food here kind of strange?”
“Yeah, that blood sausage-like dish they serve every night seems to be a local specialty.”
“That’s the thing…”
“It’s not that I can’t eat it, but it’s a bit too much, or maybe I’m just tired of it…”
“It’s edible, but the bloody smell is off-putting.”
Basically, they’re asking Father if he can do something about it with his cooking.
“U-um…”
Big Sister raised her hand.
“If it’s okay, I’d like to help… I haven’t really been of any use…”
Hmm? What’s this? For some reason, Big Sister is overlapping with Mole in my mind. Why is that?
“Raphtalia-chan, you learned how to cook from your mom, right?”
“Yes. I just thought… I’d like to help with something.”
From what I’ve heard, Big Sister hasn’t been doing much these past few days. Well, Father did say that it’s fine for her to just observe, so I suppose that’s inevitable.
“Got it. Then how about Raphtalia-chan and I cook today?”
Ren and Itsuki gave a small fist pump.
“Since everyone’s tired of the blood sausage dishes, maybe something with vegetables… or fish would be good.”
“I know how to cook fish. Since we lived near the sea, we ate it often.”
“Okay. Then let’s do it together.”
Father probably agreed to this to give Big Sister a chance to show what she can do. But… was Big Sister always like this? Father and the others went out to do the shopping.
“I’m glad. Raphtalia-chan… she seemed a little uncomfortable…”
“Everyone started learning to read and write, right?”
“Yes… Melty-chan has been teaching us carefully. Since we can’t fight due to growing pains, she said we should learn to read first, and then she’ll teach us magic later.”
“Magic, huh… We’ll have to learn that too.”
“Ren and Itsuki aren’t exactly fans of studying.”
It took a while for them to learn to read and write last time too. Ren and Itsuki frowned at my comment.
“Wouldn’t it be nice if there was a skill like ‘Otherworld Language Comprehension’?”
“Yeah…”
“There isn’t.”

At my response, Ren and Itsuki let out a deep sigh. Come to think of it, they were supposed to focus on learning magic during this stay. Since it’s fine to learn in Melromarc’s script, they need to master it, or using magic will be difficult.
